definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese food made from fish paste (surimi) that is kneaded, shaped, and then steamed, grilled, or fried. Includes kamaboko, chikuwa, and other common items.

examples.japanese: ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{練|ね}り{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Fish paste products are essential for oden.

examples.japanese: {練|ね}り{物|もの}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{竹輪|ちくわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought chikuwa from the fish paste products section.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{練|ね}り{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This region has abundant fresh fish, so there are many varieties of fish paste products.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ (to knead) and ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing/product). Refers to a broad category of processed fish foods central to Japanese cuisine.

TYPES:
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ}: kamaboko — steamed fish cake, often with a pink outer layer
- {竹輪|ちくわ}: chikuwa — tube-shaped grilled fish cake
- ⟦さつま{揚|あ}げ→さつま揚げ：07974_satsumaage⟧: satsuma-age — deep-fried fish cake
- ⟦はんぺん→はんぺん：21733_hanpen⟧: hanpen — soft, fluffy white fish cake
- {笹|ささ}かまぼこ: sasa-kamaboko — leaf-shaped fish cake (Sendai specialty)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練|ね}り{物|もの}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: fish paste products section (in a supermarket)
- {練|ね}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add fish paste products (to a dish)

USAGE:
Commonly associated with ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧ (a winter stew), ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot), and ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (bento boxes). Supermarkets have a dedicated {練|ね}り{物|もの} section, usually near the refrigerated fish products.
